FROM debian@sha256:04634311a8d5fc442b6eb06d792293c4f3e2268652ca7634e00ce8ef5cc0a28a
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libglib2.0-0 libnss3 libnspr4 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 \
    libcups2 libexpat1 libxcb1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2t64 libgbm1 libx11-6 \
    libxext6 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libudev1 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 \
    libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 fonts-liberation fontconfig \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC HOME=/tmp/capture-home
WORKDIR /bench

import json, time, subprocess, pathlib, random, hashlib, statistics, math

ROOT=pathlib.Path('/tmp/gui-capture-benchmark')
TOOLS=['playwright','puppeteer','chromiumoxide','headless_chrome']
records=json.loads((ROOT/'results'/'raw.json').read_text()) if (ROOT/'results'/'raw.json').exists() else []

def run(tool,count,prefix,mode):
    if any(r['tool']==tool and r['prefix']==prefix for r in records): return
    command=['docker','exec','-e','CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3286/getting-started','gui-capture-benchmark-286']
    if tool in TOOLS[:2]: command += ['/node/bin/node','/bench/js/capture.mjs',tool,str(count),prefix]
    else: command += [f'/bench/rust/target/release/{tool}',str(count),prefix]
    start=time.perf_counter()
    result=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
    elapsed=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
    (ROOT/'results'/f'{prefix}-{tool}.stdout').write_text(result.stdout)
    (ROOT/'results'/f'{prefix}-{tool}.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
    if result.returncode:
        failures_file=ROOT/'results'/'failures.json'
        failures=json.loads(failures_file.read_text()) if failures_file.exists() else []
        attempt=1+sum(f['tool']==tool and f['prefix']==prefix for f in failures)
        failure={'tool':tool,'mode':mode,'prefix':prefix,'attempt':attempt,'requested_captures':count,'completed_captures':sum(line.startswith('{') for line in result.stdout.splitlines()),'kind':'capture command failed','process_wall_ms':elapsed,'stderr':result.stderr,'note':'Preserved before retry; excluded from successful timing statistics. Cause not established.'}
        failures.append(failure); failures_file.write_text(json.dumps(failures,indent=2))
        (ROOT/'results'/f'{prefix}-{tool}-failed-{attempt}.stdout').write_text(result.stdout)
        (ROOT/'results'/f'{prefix}-{tool}-failed-{attempt}.stderr').write_text(result.stderr)
        print(json.dumps({'tool':tool,'mode':mode,'case':prefix,'failed_attempt':attempt,'error':result.stderr[-1200:]}),flush=True)
        if attempt < 3: return run(tool,count,prefix,mode)
        raise RuntimeError(f'{tool}: three failed attempts; original error preserved: {result.stderr}')
    lines=[json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
    summary=next(row for row in lines if row.get('summary'))
    samples=[row for row in lines if not row.get('summary')]
    for row in samples:
        file=ROOT/'results'/pathlib.Path(row['path']).name
        row['sha256']=hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        assert row['state']['hydrated'] and row['state']['heading']=='Introduction'
    record={'tool':tool,'mode':mode,'prefix':prefix,'process_wall_ms':elapsed,'summary':summary,'samples':samples}
    records.append(record)
    (ROOT/'results'/'raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({'tool':tool,'mode':mode,'case':prefix,'process_ms':round(elapsed),'captures_ms':[round(r['capture_ms']) for r in samples]}),flush=True)

(ROOT/'results').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rng=random.Random(286)
for tool in TOOLS: run(tool,2,'warmup','warmup')
for round_ in range(8):
    order=TOOLS.copy(); rng.shuffle(order)
    for tool in order: run(tool,1,f'cold-{round_}','fresh-browser')
for round_ in range(3):
    order=TOOLS.copy(); rng.shuffle(order)
    for tool in order: run(tool,5,f'warm-{round_}','reused-browser')

def stats(values):
    ordered=sorted(values)
    return {'n':len(values),'median_ms':statistics.median(values),'min_ms':min(values),'max_ms':max(values),'p95_ms':ordered[math.ceil(.95*len(values))-1]}

report={}
for tool in TOOLS:
    cold=[r for r in records if r['tool']==tool and r['mode']=='fresh-browser']
    warm=[s for r in records if r['tool']==tool and r['mode']=='reused-browser' for s in r['samples'][1:]]
    shots=[s for r in records if r['tool']==tool and r['mode']!='warmup' for s in r['samples']]
    report[tool]={'fresh_browser_process':stats([r['process_wall_ms'] for r in cold]),'launch':stats([r['summary']['launch_ms'] for r in cold]),'warm_capture':stats([r['capture_ms'] for r in warm]),'warm_page_ready':stats([r['page_ready_ms'] for r in warm]),'warm_screenshot':stats([r['screenshot_ms'] for r in warm]),'image_sha256s':sorted(set(r['sha256'] for r in shots))}
(ROOT/'results'/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2),flush=True)
